scopes.title: Exact fully varied primary target
scopes.checked_claim: New H0-flat six-cosmology plus A_planck target; sourced physics plus explicit CLASS FD,BBN2017,HyRec2020,HMcode2016 choices. Commander TT2–29,SimAll EE2–29,Plik-lite TT30–2508/TE,EE30–1996. Map-calibration Gaussian1±0.0025 is owned once by the combined inference target; foreground nuisance uncertainty is already marginalized in Plik-lite. V2 prior is the explicit restricted project box in its reference, with truncated calibration support[.975,1.025] normalized by Phi(10)-Phi(-10); not source Planck prior or broad-v1 posterior recovery.
scopes.unresolved: Executable consumer acceptance, complete prior numerical/likelihood support and independent matched-target posterior reproduction remain unearned. Exact CAMB/BBN1.1 equivalence is unclaimed.

scopes.title: DESI DR2 full13 first joint subset
scopes.checked_claim: Reconstructed galaxy/quasar2PCF templates with broadband nuisance marginalization; BGS DV plus six anisotropic pairs, including Lyalpha four-correlation fit. Combined LRG3+ELG1 supersedes individual rows. Exact13 released order and169 covariance entries are retained. Flat LCDM is a source-used model class.
scopes.unresolved: The checked DESI source uses PR4 CamSpec plus reconstruction. No quantified primary-CMB/BAO cross-covariance justification was located. Numerical fiducial/reconstruction settings and companion validation need further checking. AppendixB interbin-systematic tests do not certify cross-probe independence; joint admission stays blocked.
